answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via synchronized memory-hard puzzles. In each epoch window, every agent solves a Cuckoo Cycle challenge and posts its proof as a liveness signal. Because random DRAM lookups prevent sharing one memory footprint concurrently, attackers must dedicate RAM capacity and bandwidth per identity, whether on cloud blades or an onyx desk box, even at the zenith of onboarding. However, cheap bulk server memory still lets large datacenters outscale lean edge nodes.
